details:
First and foremost, I do not support this update. Anti-Cheat in a non-competitive and social game is uncalled for. With that said, I enjoy the game and would like to work together with devs rather than fight them, for now.
I truly hope you consider one day embracing mods and creating an approval system instead.
Please continue to improve IK. The IK 2.0 update was great, but I and many others still have issues that we previously solved with mods. Laying down puts your chest way too high. Full body calibration is sensitive. There are not enough calibration options anyway, regardless of IK 2.0.
Add more in-game tweaks to yourself and the environment. Avatar scaling, disabling seats and pickups, etc.
Improve upon the safety system. An option to hide avatars that are far away. Physbones for certain trust ranks. Loading only a certain amount of avatars per instance, regardless of rank. Performance in bigger lobbies needs to be improved. Crashing will happen regardless of anti-cheat, as most are using avatars and shaders to do so. Please improve the stability of your game and/or implement anti-crash for these particular events. (Which can happen regardless of your safety settings.)
Add more personalization options. Menu colors and/or themes. UI sizes. Being able to see your VRChat pictures folder while you sit in a loading screen.
More camera options, including cinematic animations.
Many content creators, avatar showcases, etc, have used Camera Animations mod for their JOBS. Removing mods greatly impacts those that are pushing your game, VRChat into social media and making it popular. As well as the fun stuff, I would like to see support for higher resolution photos as many of the worlds and avatars created by VRChats users are beautiful and should be captured as such.
Calibration and viewpoint tweaking. Allow more small tweaks inside of the game to improve full-body and half-body experience.
Also, please fix the clipping of avatars that get close to your face. I'm a little sick of seeing the insides of my friends when they're nowhere near me.
Along with all the suggestions I've made, as well as those many other users have made. Please ensure that you implement accessibility features. I don't mean spend 6 months creating a closed captioning option. I mean now. Ensure everyone is able to play VRChat. A menu that spawns in front of your view, not in one locked spot. A closed captioning system. In-game TTS support.
title: Some feature's I'd like to see implemented into VRChat now that Anti-Cheat has been released.
